card.name: Ends of neurological symptom words
card.fires_on: The final piece of a split-up neurological or motor symptom term, mainly 'idity' in 'rigidity' and 'ural' in 'postural' hypotension, in antipsychotic warning text.

modes.label: Rigidity in symptom lists
modes.description: The ending 'idity' of 'rigidity' in a list of neuromuscular symptoms such as tremor and myoclonus.

modes.label: Postural hypotension in falls warnings
modes.description: The ending 'ural' of 'postural' before 'hypotension' in the falls warning for antipsychotics.

modes.label: Knee jerk
modes.description: The word 'knee' before 'jerk' when describing neurological signs.
